svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make eight. Each is 6.8 mm across and 10 mm long when joined.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Socket (pulley side), 6 mm long: a 3.3 mm bore 4 mm deep from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front, a 1.4 mm hole through the back for the pulley line, two

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2.05 mm holes across it 4 mm from the back, and a groove 3 mm deep

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: round the outside over those holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Plug (tendon side): a 6.8 mm head 4 mm long with a 1.4 mm hole for the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tendon, and a 3.2 mm stem 3.8 mm long with a groove round it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 2 mm steel balls sit in the holes; a ring of 0.4 mm spring wire in

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the outside groove presses them into the stem's groove. The wire

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sets the pull-out force: about 60 N, set and recorded at TRL 4.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: one on each finger line, just in front of its balance pulley.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the plug pulls out and clicks back by hand at the set force.
